items.title: Inkling-2-Mini hits 10.04x on KernelBench-Mega on one RTX PRO 6000 via a persistent Triton megakernel
items.summary: A local run of Inkling-2-Mini wrote a 1,119-line single-launch Triton megakernel for a hybrid KDA/MLA/MoE model and scored 10.04x on KernelBench-Mega, ahead of the other models listed on the same GPU. The post lists the 2.9-hour trace and the speedup steps; no repo is linked.

doubt.pushback: Single-author run with no linked trace or code; replies not read.

items.title: TensorFold 1.3.4: Qwen3.8-27B decode up to 42.2% faster on an Intel Arc Pro B70 after a 121k-token prompt
items.summary: TensorFold 1.3.4 reports plain decode on Qwen3.8-27B up to 42.2% faster on an Intel Arc Pro B70 after a 121,022-token prompt, with the same output tokens. The release also makes model pulls work through proxies and resume stalled downloads.

items.title: Google gemini-api-cli open-sourced: a CLI plus skill that gives agents Gemini video analysis, OCR and media generation
items.summary: A Google developer points to the open-source gemini-api-cli, which with an API key and an installed skill lets coding agents call Gemini for video analysis, OCR and TTS, music, video and image generation.

items.title: Colab CLI lets agents spend Gemini Ultra plan Colab credits on GPUs without notebooks
items.summary: A user reports the Colab CLI lets an agent run jobs on H100 or RTX 6000 Pro hours drawn from the Gemini Ultra plan's monthly Colab credits, Modal-style and with no notebook. The credit and GPU-hour figures are the poster's own and nothing official is linked.

doubt.pushback: Credit and GPU-hour numbers come from the poster with no primary link.
